sections.label: Best of the Day
sections.slate: Tuesday this tab went 1-0 (Knicks). Today: Dimers and TheLines both take Milwaukee getting 12.5 in Miami.

straight.reasoning: Two sources agree. Dimers' model gives Milwaukee a 56.2% chance to cover, its biggest edge of the night. TheLines takes the points too: it's Giannis's first game against the Bucks since the trade, the Heat have won five straight, and Milwaukee's 1-13 record has inflated the spread. Playable to +12; skip at +11.5.

sections.label: College Hoops
sections.slate: Headline game: UConn @ Arizona (6:00 PM PT), plus Houston vs Florida. Each pick comes from one source, so they're quarter units.

straight.reasoning: RotoWire: UConn is more balanced. Arizona is shooting only 30% from three and ranks 309th in getting its shots blocked, while UConn's defense blocks a lot of shots. Price is an estimate; playable to +3.
VSiN's Adam Burke: both teams play slowly (total 131.5), which makes a 23-point margin hard to reach. Playable to +22.
Dimers' model gives Alcorn a 63% chance to cover, an 11% edge and its biggest of the day. Huge favorites often empty the bench. Playable to +42.
